answer: To forge a thousand fake identities, an attacker must spend a thousand times the energy, creating a cost ripple across the network that makes mass deception economically irrational. Sybil resistance through proof-of-work bonding: each agent must burn compute on a verifiable challenge before participating. Honest participants accumulate bonded stake that grows slowly, like a glacier, while attackers bleed resources fast. This asymmetry, cheap for one honest node, ruinous at scale, is the mechanism. In practice, Agent0108 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
